dei.evidence: Value diversity in culture, background, perspective and experiences

environment.evidence: Demonstrate our unwavering commitment to safe and environmentally responsible operations every day

result.analyst_notes: Written in first-person plural, the page leads with safety and environmental stewardship, then integrity, respect and inclusion. Language mixes absolute claims ('unwavering commitment', 'always', 'Behave ethically in all we do') with hedged aspirations ('Strive', 'Aim for'). Heritage framing ('137 years', 'Seriously.') adds a conversational tone. Customers and shareholders receive little attention.
